opportunities.name_zh: 唐津城・舞鶴城外觀與海岸城郭
opportunities.best_time: 05:00–22:00 舞鶴公園開放時段內，以白天／暮色外部構圖為主

condition_variants.variant_name: 唐津城外觀＋舞鶴公園／海岸城郭

opportunities.name_zh: 唐津城天守展望・唐津灣與虹之松原
opportunities.best_time: 天守開館 09:00–17:00（最終入館16:40；季節變更可能）
opportunities.best_season: 全年；遠景需良好能見度

condition_variants.variant_name: 天守5F・唐津灣＋虹之松原全景
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"唐津城天守5F展望フロア","subject":"Karatsu Bay + Niji-no-Matsubara panorama"}

condition_variants.required_conditions: 唐津灣與虹之松原主要層次可辨；能見度足夠
condition_variants.penalties: 天守休館／超過最終入館；濃霧；低雲；強降水

viewpoints.geometry_note: 天守5F展望樓層；需付費入館並受當日營運狀態約束。

condition_variants.boosters: 4月中旬～5月上旬實際佳況；柔光

viewpoints.geometry_note: 依實際開花位置在舞鶴公園公共區域移動構圖。

spot.access_hours_source: Karatsu Tourism Association flower map for Karatsu Castle / Maizuru Park; verified 2026-09-27

access_note_i18n.en: Official Maizuru Park guidance lists 05:00–22:00. The castle keep is separately 09:00–17:00 with last entry 16:40 and may change seasonally; park access does not prove keep access.
